_comment: Look library v3 (docs/LIBRARY_V1.md, section "Library v3"): library v2 + 12 classic colour looks (recipes sim/recipes/library_v3.json). Fallback for the 20-look loader: the best 20 colour looks, best first (mono uses its own presets).

cl_neg.name: Classic Neg
cl_neg.notes: Superia-style negative: teal-green cast, punchy mids, light skies.

kchrome25.name: Kodachrome25
kchrome25.notes: Kodachrome 25 slide (GarethB, mu-43): dense, rich reds, muted cyan/green, deep shadows. Advice: contrast +2, H-2 M+3 S-5.

portra.name: Portra 400
portra.notes: Warm pastel portrait negative: glowing skin, soft contrast.

kchrome.name: Kodachrome64
kchrome.notes: Rich deep reds, golden yellows, dense cyan-blue skies, olive greens.

gold.name: Gold 200
gold.notes: Golden consumer negative: sunny yellows, muted cyan skies.

portra160.name: Portra 160
portra160.notes: Fine-grain portrait negative (I. Mitropoulos, om-recipes): natural skin, quiet greens, soft contrast.

ektar.name: Ektar 100
ektar.notes: Ultra-vivid fine-grain negative: saturated reds and blues.

velvia.name: Velvia
velvia.notes: Saturated landscape slide film: deep skies, dense greens, crushed shadows.

cl_chrome.name: Cl. Chrome
cl_chrome.notes: Documentary look: muted greens and yellows, cyan skies, hard shadows.

superia.name: Superia 400
superia.notes: Fuji Superia 400 (J. Bloomer, om-recipes): green-leaning negative, cyan skies, lively mids.

ultramax.name: UltraMax 400
ultramax.notes: Kodak consumer negative: warm, punchy reds/yellows, olive greens, visible grain.

cinestill.name: CineStill800
cinestill.notes: Tungsten cinema film: cool cast, red bloom (bloom + bloom_tint red: the glow's Cr spreads far more than its luma, docs/HALATION_RED.md section 8) plus red/orange light.

ektachrome.name: Ektachrome
ektachrome.notes: Clean, cool slide film: neutral skin, bright saturated blues.

pro400h.name: Pro 400H
pro400h.notes: Airy pastel negative: minty greens, light cyan skies.

v500t.name: Vision3 500T
v500t.notes: Tungsten cinema negative in daylight: cool teal cast, warm lights, open shadows.

fuji200.name: Fujicolor200
fuji200.notes: Fujicolor C200 (J. Bloomer, om-recipes): warm yellows, fresh greens, soft contrast.

provia400.name: Provia 400
provia400.notes: Fujichrome Provia 400X slide: magenta-red cast, lavender skies, rich blues, deep reds, dark greens, fast fall to black, fine grain. Advice: contrast +1.

eterna.name: Eterna
eterna.notes: Cinema negative: flat, open shadows, quiet teal-leaning colour.

polaroid.name: Polaroid
polaroid.notes: Integral instant film: faded, low contrast, warm highlights, cyan-green shadows.

xpro.name: Cross Proc.
xpro.notes: E-6 slide in C-41: hard contrast, yellow-green highlights, cyan skies, yellowed skin.
